title: 🎓 JAMB CAPS 2026/2027 Is Now Active!
message:
Schools have started uploading admission offers. Check your admission status NOW before it's too late!

📋 How to Check:

• Visit efacility.jamb.gov.ng
• Login with your JAMB email & password
• Click 'Check Admission Status'
• Click 'Access My CAPS'
• Click 'Admission Status'

✅ If Admitted:
• Send ACCEPT or REJECT as SMS to 55019 or 66019 (use JAMB-linked number)
• You have 4 weeks to accept
• Print your JAMB Admission Letter after accepting

📱 Phone Users:
Use Chrome → Request Desktop Site if options don't show fully.

🔴 Don't miss your admission — check TODAY!
